units: Targ. Ex. XXVI, 9 ותְעוּף Ms. I (Ms. II ותְעִיף; O. ed. Berl. a. Y. ותֵיעוֹף; oth. ed. ותָעֵיף Af.).—Part. pass. (עֵיף) עִיף. Ib. XXVIII, 16; XXXIX, 9 (Y. ed. Vien. עֵיף).—
<cite ref="Chullin 51b:14">Ḥull. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>עִיף מֵיעַף</he> Ar. (Alf. <he>עָיֵיף מיעף</he>; ed. <he>עוף ומעופף</he>) if the cloak is well folded.
<cite ref="Ketubot 67b:15">Keth. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>עַיְּיפִינְהוּ וכ׳</he> he doubled them (his gifts) and sent them to him.

<cite ref="Shabbat 134a:12">Sabb. 134ᵃ</cite> <he>ולְעַיֵּיף ליה לעילאי</he> (not <he>ועייף</he>; Rashi <he>ולעַפְפֵיה</he>; Ms. Rashi <he>וליכייפיה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10) let him bend the border upward.
<cite ref="Eruvin 96b:10-11">Erub. 96ᵇ</cite> <he>אדעתא … עייפינהו</he> he doubled them with the intention of making borders to a cloak.
